title: config.json
description: User configuration. Additive fields are allowed (readers ignore what they do not know); removing or changing the meaning of a field needs a cfgVersion bump plus a migration in Update-MgConfigPolicy. Values that 2.5/2.6 installers wrote as defaults (onExit=adopt, guardWindowSec=120) are migrated once - see cfgVersion.

version.description: Legacy format marker, kept for old builds.

cfgVersion.description: Policy version. Absent/0 = legacy 2.5/2.6 config; 2 = first 2.6.1 build (repaired); >=3 = migrated, values are a user decision and are never overwritten.

miamiGraphicsDir.description: Miami Graphics folder; empty when not installed.

majesticJson.description: Path to the Majestic launcher config (cache path source).

lastFullDiscovery.description: ISO timestamp of the last full path rediscovery (older than 24 h triggers a new one).

gameProcesses.description: Process name patterns that mean 'the game is running'.

launcherProcesses.description: Launcher patterns (used for the .bin insurance and the tray).

autoCleanDlccache.description: Opt-in: archive dlccache .dat files on launch.

onExit.description: Deprecated. Does NOT enable adopt any more (2.6.1); use allowAdopt.

allowAdopt.description: Opt-in: in-game edits become the new golden on exit. Default false - the golden is restored instead.

sessionGuard.description: Kill-switch for the in-session drift guard.

guardWindowSec.description: 0 = guard the whole session (default); >0 = only the first N seconds after the game starts.

docsRoot.description: Pinned Documents location; a change breaks the Rockstar SDK (error 1002) and is reported by diagnose.
